'''J7R-T'''<ref name="Hasbro">{{DisneyToyCite|set=Star Wars: Droid Factory (toy line)|packtype=Multipack|pack=B5-R4 · R0-1N6 · GS-C1B · J7R-T|altlink=https://yakfaceforums.com/main/2025/04/11/tbobf-droidfactory-set-revealed}}</ref> was an [[R5 series astromech droid]] that was active during the [[New Republic Era]], serving in the [[Boba Fett's Palace|palace]] of [[Daimyo]], [[Boba Fett]].<ref name="The Streets of Mos Espa" />

{{Char-stub}}

==Behind the scenes==
A card released on the ''[[Star Wars: Card Trader]]'' app incorrectly identified J7R-T as an [[R4 astromech droid]].<ref name="Card Trader">{{SWCT|set=The Book of Boba Fett Box|cardname=Boba Fett's Palace R4 Server Droid}}</ref>
